rows.text: Roll again if the captain is at a space port, otherwise an Objective Item has been found that may be required for the current mission (check the away mission’s details). If it’s not needed, it is in- stead an ancient alien artefact (AAA) worth 50c.
Use to gain +2 damage to your next damage roll when using a Dex weapon.
Use to gain +2 damage to your next damage roll when using a Str weapon.
Use to add +2 Def against enemy’s next damage roll.
Roll on table A – Armour and add “(M)” before its name. It gains +0.2 Def and gains +100 credit to its value and 20 credits to its fix cost.
Use to deduct -3 pips from the acid track.
Use to replenish up to 6 lost HP.
Use to add +10 Int to next test.
Use to add +10 Str to next test.
Use to add +10 Dex to next test.
Use to deduct -3 pips from the plague track.
Roll on table I – Implants for the patch that is found. Add “Patch” after its name when you add it to the log sheet (e.g. if you roll 33-36 you will have a “Nimbler Patch”.
Use to add +10 to a result when rolling on the next table.
Use to gain 1 karma point.
Use to gain +10 Int until you next shade a pip on the time track.
Use to gain +10 Str until you next shade a pip on the time track.
Use to gain +10 Dex until you next shade a pip on the time track.
Use to gain 1 point of primary Dex.
Use to gain 1 point of primary Int.
Use to gain 1 point of primary Str.
Use to gain 1 point of primary HP.
Roll on table W – Weapon and add “(M)” before its name. Add +2 to its Dmg value. It gains +600 credit to its value.
Roll on table I – Implants for the implant that is found.
Use to gain 1 Life point.
A more valuable trapping has been found. Roll on table TB – Trappings B
Powered armour has been found. Roll on table A – Armour for the armour and then on table P - Powers for its power and adjust its value.
A powered weapon has been found. Roll on table W – Weapons for the weapon and then on table P - Powers for its power and adjust its value.
